deviation: A0_core was interrupted by a host restart after 318 of 1,320 rows and resumed with scripts/run_v4_resume.py, which imports the frozen experiments/run_v4.py (expand, job) unchanged, keeps complete rows and runs only the missing specifications.

deviation: Execution order A1_review, A3_factorial (amendment 1), A0_core (resumed), A3_selective, A3_scenarios instead of A0, A1, A3_selective, A3_scenarios followed by A3_factorial, as amendment 1 had stated.
